liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Looks Like Rain** (2 reviews): Reviewer points to strong, standout guitar lines in Looks Like Rain; Jerry's lead in Looks Like Rain is singled out as exceptional [18][19]
- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Terrapin very tight; Reviewer deems it the best Terrapin they've heard, building slowly with the band unhurried [18][19]
- **Crazy Fingers** (2 reviews): Reviewer describes Crazy Fingers as sweet; Crazy Fingers emerging from Space is a highlight for this reviewer [18][28]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Reviewer calls this their favorite Iko Iko of the modern era; the matrix crowd audibly responds [19]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer attended and, from a cassette's first-set side, fell asleep for years to Row Jimmy [26]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (1 review): Along with Row Jimmy and Built To Last, it formed a soothing closing run on the reviewer's cassette side [26]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer lists Bird Song as a highlight [28]
- It was a second encore [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-08-18 t01 Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd89-08-18 t02 Cold Rain & Snow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd89-08-18 t03 New Minglewood Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd89-08-18 t04 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd89-08-18 t05 When I Paint My Masterpiece**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd89-08-18 t06 Built To Last**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd89-08-18 t07 Victim Or The Crime**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd89-08-18 t08 Bird Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-08-18.140721.ultramatrix.sbd.pcm.gans.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 175 min [1]
- **gd89-08-18.sbd.4796.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 171 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Matrix has left and right channels swapped, so Brent comes from the left speaker [25]
- **gd89-08-18.sbd.bertha.9964.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer judges this soundboard version the best-sounding, since levels needed raising across the board; Reviewer considers this soundboard upload the best of the show's Archive copies, with more lift than other uploads [20][27]
- **gd1989-08-18.sbd.ladner.tetzeli.fix-4796.34570.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1989-08-18.164142.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 173 min [6]
- **gd1989-08-18.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83774.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 165 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer praises the Charlie Miller remaster's sound quality, noting Phil's bass is prominent [29]
- **gd1989-08-18.141056.set2.ultramatrix.hifi.vhs.gans.miller.clugston.flac1644**: soundboard; 15 songs; 118 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [15]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says they were at the show and found it sublime [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-08-18.140721.ultramatrix.sbd.pcm.gans.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Ultramatrix DAT > PCM [1]
- **gd89-08-18.sbd.4796.sbeok.shnf**: source: Healy Matrix Digital SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHNv3 [2]
- **gd89-08-18.sbd.bertha.9964.sbefail.shnf**: source: Jay Ashley (Bertha) remaster of Healy SBD mix [3]
- **gd1989-08-18.sbd.ladner.tetzeli.fix-4796.34570.shnf**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli Fix of shnid 4796; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Fix made the CD 2 to CD 3 transition seamless and cleaned up errors using shntool, with overlap from Fishman [4]
- **gd1989-08-18.164142.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 21, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-XG90) [6]
- **gd1989-08-18.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83774.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [11]
- **gd1989-08-18.141056.set2.ultramatrix.hifi.vhs.gans.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Master Soundboard Ultramatrix DAT > Hi-Fi VHS [15]
